visible_text: マイク と 画面の音 を聞いています
決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く

answers.q1: Partially. A red '録音中 00:02' badge and 'マイク と 画面の音 を聞いています' tell you it is live-recording mic + system audio, but the only meeting identifier is '01:53 の会議' — a duration/timestamp, not an actual meeting name, calendar title, or participant list, so you can't tell WHICH meeting this is.
answers.q2: No. There's a link at the bottom labeled 'AI が見ている資料' (material the AI is looking at), but no document name, thumbnail, or count is shown next to it, and the transcript/summary/decisions/todo panels all say they're empty ('待っています…' / 'まだ発話がありません。'). So it's unclear whether any material is actually loaded right now.
answers.q3: Mostly one surface — a single rounded card holds the meeting panel and transcript panel — but a separate small dark pill toolbar floats above/overlapping the top edge, which reads as a second, distinct control layer rather than part of the same card.
answers.q4: The recording status ('録音中 00:02') and live transcript panel, since they signal the app is actively capturing the meeting right now.
answers.q5: The meeting title is just an elapsed-time stamp ('01:53 の会議') rather than a real name, so it gives no context. 'AI が見ている資料' shows no actual material, leaving it ambiguous if anything is attached. The screen is dominated by near-identical empty placeholder lines ('を待っています…') across transcript, decisions, and todos, which feels redundant and makes the surface feel barren rather than informative.

weaknesses.what: Meeting label is a duration/timestamp ('01:53 の会議'), not the actual meeting name or source app
weaknesses.fix: Show the real calendar event title or source app/window name instead of an elapsed-time placeholder

weaknesses.what: 'AI が見ている資料' link gives no visible document name, icon, or count, so presence of source material is unverifiable
weaknesses.fix: Show the material name/thumbnail or an explicit 'no material' state instead of a bare link

weaknesses.what: Multiple sections (transcript, 決まったこと, やること) all show near-duplicate 'を待っています…' placeholder copy, making the screen feel empty/redundant
weaknesses.fix: Collapse or visually de-emphasize empty sections until content arrives, or use a single shared empty-state treatment
